relationships.subject: SPP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Silencing of SPP1 inactivated the ERK pathway.

relationships.subject: SPP1
relationships.evidence_quote: CCI significantly increased the EGF and VEGF levels, while decreasing the TGF‐β levels, and knockdown of SPP1 rescued these CCI‐induced effects.

relationships.subject: SPP1
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression levels of IL‐1β, TNF‐α, and IL‐6 were significantly elevated by CCI, which were markedly abrogated by the knockdown of SPP1

relationships.subject: SPP1
relationships.evidence_quote: Knockdown of SPP1 significantly increased the PWT and PWL in CCI rats

relationships.subject: IGF-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The protein levels of p‐AKT, p‐MEK, and p‐ERK were downregulated by the knockdown of SPP1, which were significantly elevated by IGF‐1

key_findings: SPP1 is upregulated in DRG of CCI rats and its knockdown relieves pain behaviors, reduces IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IL-6, EGF and VEGF, and inactivates ERK.
IGF-1 activation of ERK reversed the effects of SPP1 silencing.
